messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Internal error number 3022
parts:
Can you explain again the circumstances under which this problem arises?  Am I correct in my understanding of the events:
  • you have worked with a Distance for Windows project and closed the project
  • you reopen the project and are presented with this message, correct?
It would seem that the database Distance for Windows uses to store information about your analysis has a problem.

I don't know the exact remedy for this problem, but perhaps you might be able to work with a backup copy of your project.  Have a look in the directory where the project resides to see if there is a file and directory with the same name, but with a tilde and dollar sign in front (these are the backup file and folder for your project).  See below


Copy both to a new location, rename them and try to open that project, which may not have the problem. 

Hope that is helpful.
